<thought>To propose a single-step retrosynthesis using a Diels‑Alder reaction, I will first look for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a [4+2] cycloaddition forming a six‑membered ring. This can be identified by searching the template catalog for a reaction that forms a 6‑6 bond (a new C–C bond between two sp2 carbons) and changes the bond order of two double bonds to single bonds. I will use the `search_template_catalog_by_criteria` tool with the target SMILES and appropriate criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)", "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
